desc: Read input and build the graph using adjacency lists.
Use BFS or DFS to find connected components and determine the bipartition of each component, counting the sizes of the two sets and the number of edges in each component.
For each component, calculate the number of available moves as $A_C \times B_C - M_C$.
Sum the available moves across all components.
If the total sum is odd, print "Aoki"; otherwise, print "Takahashi".
